name: lane-switch
prompt: Quick soft air whoosh of a runner darting sideways one lane, short light swish with a faint fabric flap.

name: jump
prompt: Light bouncy leap sound, rising airy swoop with a soft shoe push-off from pavement.

name: slide
prompt: Short gritty shoe slide scrape across asphalt, low friction scuff trailing off quickly.

name: token-pickup
prompt: Bright metallic token plucked from the air, small coin clink with a clean ringing shimmer.

name: near-miss
prompt: Fast airy pass-by whoosh of an obstacle rushing past very close, brief and sharp.

name: invalid-move
prompt: Dull muted wooden clunk, short dampened knock signaling a rejected action.

name: crash
prompt: Heavy body-impact thud into a metal barrier with clattering panel and tumbling debris.

name: goal-reached
prompt: Four bright ascending mallet bell notes, cheerful celebratory finish-line flourish.

name: countdown-beep
prompt: Single clean mid-pitched electronic countdown beep, short and precise.

name: go-signal
prompt: Higher sustained starter beep, clear race-start signal tone.

name: ui-tap
prompt: Soft plastic button press, gentle short UI tap click.

name: achievement
prompt: Two-tone bright chime reward with a sparkling medal jingle, satisfying unlock sound.
